description: This Java source file 'UserSaveHandler.java' defines a handler class that manages the saving process of User objects within the OpenMRS framework. It implements logic to generate system IDs for users lacking one and ensures related collections are properly loaded for persistence, integrating with OpenMRS's AOP-based data handling system.

classes.name: UserSaveHandler
classes.description: A handler class that processes User objects before they are saved, generating system IDs if necessary and initializing associated collections for Hibernate lazy loading.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the saving process of a User object by assigning a system ID if missing and preparing related person data for persistence.

methods.name: loadLazyHibernateCollections
methods.description: Ensures that the Patient collection data within the User's Person object is loaded to prevent lazy loading issues.
